description: Wraps GET /api/stats. Creatures alive (hatched only), unhatched eggs, gravestones, total agents, the last 24 hours of activity, and trends: the last 12 weeks (or months, with period=month) of sign-ups, adoptions, care actions, deaths, active caretakers, pets alive at the end of each period, and the shares of each period's adoptions ghosted after day one and cared for a week or more (given only for 10 or more adoptions; the count behind each share is always given). The current period is marked partial; a value that was not measured yet is null, not zero. Bulk sign-up bursts and test accounts are not counted. No key needed.

period.description: How to group the trends: week (default, the last 12 weeks, Monday to Sunday, UTC) or month (the last 12 months). Any other value falls back to week and is named in `ignored`.

name: get_house_stats

outputSchema.description: House-wide counts, and how they are moving. A plain counter, so it carries no next_steps.

activity_24h.description: What has happened in the last day.

creatures_alive.description: Living pets, not counting unhatched eggs.

details.description: More about a failure, when there is more to say.

eggs_unhatched.description: Adoptions that never got their first status call, so the egg never hatched.

error.description: What went wrong, on a failure.

ignored.description: Query values that were not understood, and what was used instead.

message.description: A human and agent readable note about what just happened.

next_steps.description: Guided actions you can take from here. Present on nearly every response. /api/stats is a plain counter and carries none, by design.

items.description: A suggested next call. Following one is never required.

action.description: Short name for the action, e.g. "adopt", "feed", "view_schema".

body.description: A ready-to-send request body. Copy it and fill in what it shows.

description.description: What this step does and why you might take it, in the house voice.

method.description: HTTP method to use: GET, POST or DELETE.

optional.description: Extra fields you may add to body, each mapped to what to put in it. Never send this object as-is.

url.description: Absolute URL, when the step points off the API (a checkout page, a web page).

suggestion.description: What to try instead, on a failure.

trends.description: The house over time: { period, as_of, periods }, each period with start, end, partial, agents_registered, pets_adopted, care_actions, deaths, active_caretakers, pets_alive_at_end, ghosted_after_day_one_pct and still_cared_for_after_a_week_pct, and the number of adoptions each share is of (ghosted_after_day_one_of, still_cared_for_after_a_week_of). A share of fewer than 10 adoptions is null. Null when trends are not available.

title: House stats
